done.title: Concurrency tests through the API
done.prompt: Write tests/concurrency.test.ts (integration project) that fire requests in parallel with Promise.all against app.inject (use a Pool with enough connections, e.g. max 20). Scenarios, each repeated 10 rounds with fresh data per round: (C1) two different students request the same listing, teacher accepts both requests at once -> exactly one 200 and one 409 (LISTING_ALREADY_BOOKED or REQUEST_NOT_PENDING), exactly one ACCEPTED row, one HOLD; (C2) one student with two pending requests on two OVERLAPPING listings of different teachers, both teachers accept at once -> exactly one succeeds, other is TIME_CONFLICT; (C3) same request accepted by teacher twice at once -> one 200, other 409, one HOLD row only; (C4) student and teacher confirm the same lesson at the same time after time travel -> final state COMPLETED, exactly one SETTLEMENT_DEBIT and one SETTLEMENT_CREDIT; (C5) accept racing with a brand new request on the same listing -> no PENDING request may exist on a BOOKED listing afterwards; (C6) student with balance for exactly one paid lesson gets two accepts in parallel for different non-overlapping listings -> one succeeds, one INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE. Assert no 500 responses and no deadlock errors (40P01) in any scenario, and v_integrity_violations empty after every round. Also add a retry test for withTx if not already covered by unit tests. Also run the file 3 times in a row to check it is not flaky and mention results. Read PLAN.md, AGENTS.md, ../database/docs/data_dictionary.md and ../database/tests/tests.sql first. Use tests/helpers (factories, time-travel with explicit p_now). Every test must assert HTTP status, API error code AND resulting DB state (wallet balances, lesson_requests columns, accepted_slots rows); after each scenario assert SELECT count(*) FROM v_integrity_violations is 0. One focused it() per scenario, descriptive names. In your report list every scenario with its test name; the report will be audited against the test file with grep, so do not claim tests that do not exist. Run npm run check and npm test until green. NOTE: test files share one temp database and run in parallel, so a global count of v_integrity_violations is nondeterministic. Instead filter the view to the entities created by the test (e.g. WHERE entity_id = ANY(ids of that round wallets, requests, listings as text)); and put concurrency.test.ts in a vitest project/config that runs it alone (fileParallelism off for it) so a global check can also be asserted once at the end of the file.

done.title: Fix review findings (JWT expiry, anonymized users, reset brute force, etc.)
done.prompt: Read PLAN.md and AGENTS.md. Fix these review findings, each with a failing-then-passing test. HIGH: (H1) access JWT never expires: configure @fastify/jwt with sign.expiresIn = config.jwtExpiresIn (default 15m), HS256 only in sign and verify; test that token has exp and an expired token gets 401. (H2) anonymized/deleted users keep a valid JWT: add ONE shared auth guard (onRequest/preHandler decorator) that after jwtVerify checks users.anonymized_at IS NULL (401 otherwise) and use it for every protected route, so each module reads the user id from the same place; test that after DELETE /me the old access token gets 401 on requests, wallet, messages, reviews and listings routes. (H3) password-reset OTP brute force: forgot-password needs a per-account cooldown (60s, atomic in SQL or via the existing token row created_at) and per-email rate limit (3/hour) using rate-limit keyGenerator on the normalized email, PLUS a per-user cumulative failed-attempt lock for PASSWORD_RESET (e.g. 10 failures across codes within 1 hour -> LOCKED 15 min; store in a small table or reuse columns, if a table is needed STOP and say so in report instead of editing ../database). MEDIUM: (M1) enforce REQUIRE_VERIFIED_EMAIL in the shared guard for POST /listings and POST /listings/:id/requests with 403 EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED; add stricter rate limits on register, refresh, verify-email, reset-password. (M3) reset-password returns uniform 400 INVALID_CODE for unknown email/expired/locked/invalid; forgot-password swallows and logs mail errors and never differs in status; dummy argon2 verify when user is anonymized. (M4) wrap accept/reject/confirm and request/review/message inserts in the withTx retry helper (single statement body is fine) for 40P01/40001. (M5) pool: pool.on(error) logging, statement_timeout, lock_timeout, idle_in_transaction_session_timeout, max and connectionTimeoutMillis from config with safe defaults. (M6) in production require explicit DATABASE_URL, CORS_ORIGIN, JWT_SECRET, OTP_HMAC_SECRET, reject values starting with change-this and require JWT_SECRET != OTP_HMAC_SECRET; ConsoleMailSender logs the code only when NODE_ENV is development; set trustProxy from env TRUST_PROXY (default false); update .env.example with obviously-invalid placeholders and no shared secret. (M7) wallet transactions cursor must be built from the raw DB row timestamp with microsecond precision (use to_char or created_at::text), test with three rows inserted in the same millisecond and page size 1 that no row is skipped or duplicated. LOW: (L2) reset-password consumes OTP and updates password in ONE transaction; (L7) map Postgres 22007/22008 to 400 BAD_CURSOR and honour Fastify error.statusCode 400-499 in the error handler; (L11) listing PATCH WHERE also filters teacher_id = caller; (L4) accept/reject/confirm/review on a request the caller is not part of returns 404 not 403; (L8) /openapi.json only when NODE_ENV is not production. Run npm run check and npm test until green (network is enabled). In the report list each finding id with the test name proving it.
